Show Reel 2008: Lastpixel

Andy CASA, UCL East


LASTPIXEL showreel 2008 from Ben Morris on Vimeo.


Lastpixel's showreel above illustrates 22 projects the company completed in-house. Setup in 2004 the company has worked on over 500 projects to date. Its a solid showreel and we especially like the opening visualisation.

See http://www.lastpixel.com.au for more info...
